sources.exact: explicit artifact reference, task type or exact pattern
sources.structured: structured hints are matched against request context
sources.semantic: a versioned/thresholded score supplied to the internal selection service; it is a projection input, not authority

progressiveLoading: L1: immutable definition is loaded only for L0 candidates
L2: applicability, dependency, capability and policy gates execute before selection
authority: P02 PostgreSQL status and active pointer are rechecked
memory, Redis, pgvector and FTS never authorize an Artifact
scope: no Goal, Plan, Attempt, Skill or MCP invocation
